Status: Source sanitized; external rotation/history cleanup pending
Evidence: appsettings.json; cookies.txt; login.json; local .NET User Secrets
ImpactAndLimits: Credential material is tracked; validity and external exposure were not tested.
Remediation: Preserved missing local development settings in the existing User Secrets file; cleared five tracked DB/Redis/SMS/bridge configuration values and login/cookie artifacts; removed literal credentials from the old precheck. Rotate server credentials and review history separately.
CompletionCriteria: Current source contains no values at the identified keys; old credentials must fail after external rotation. Full history/legacy-crypto review remains open.

Finding: Any signed-in user could reset an arbitrary user password
ImpactAndLimits: Controller required login but action had no role or target-user authorization.
Remediation: SuperAdmin policy now covers arbitrary-user reset and legacy global account creation/activation/deletion. Legacy account creation hashes its password. Credential-version validation rejects old cookies after password, role or company changes.
CompletionCriteria: Local middleware tests return 401 for anonymous, 403 for user types 1/2, and admit type 3; verify reset and session revocation on staging.

Finding: Global Redis administration exposed to ordinary users
ImpactAndLimits: Authenticated users could enumerate, extend, delete or flush global keys.
Remediation: Applied SuperAdmin policy to all five actions.
CompletionCriteria: Local middleware role matrix passes; authorized staging checks must not flush real data.

Status: Fixed locally; legacy ownership assignment/staging pending
Finding: Indoor plans required authentication and creator/company scope
ImpactAndLimits: The existing model has creator fields, but the original controller neither set nor scoped them. Null-creator records are now visible only to super-admins.
Remediation: Added authentication and shared company/creator query predicates; new plans record the signed-in creator. Company sharing follows the existing app model; confirm product policy and assign orphan creators through an approved data process.
CompletionCriteria: Local two-company/creator/orphan tests and SQL translation pass; verify actual rows and deployed cross-company reads/writes.

Status: Provider/query-header/clutter fixes verified locally; wider route review pending
Finding: Request parameters override authenticated database region
ImpactAndLimits: country_code/countryCode/region and x-country-code are checked before the authenticated country claim. Cross-region impact depends on identities/data in each database.
Remediation: Ordinary users derive database from signed region; middleware rejects conflicting query/header selectors; ordinary users no longer cross to TW through clutter fallback or legacy admin routing. Regional login/rate-limit keys are isolated. Review remaining body-driven service/bridge region contracts.
CompletionCriteria: Local IN/TW query/header and legacy-admin routing tests pass; deployed identity collisions, alternate body parameters and caches still require assessment.

Status: Reviewed routes fixed locally; broader endpoint audit pending
Finding: Site prediction reads and mutations lack consistent resource access checks
ImpactAndLimits: Listing can query all site_prediction rows; scenario/delete service uses supplied project/source identifiers without caller scope.
Remediation: Shared project/company/creator predicates now scope ProcessCSV listing/upload, MapView.UploadSitePredictionCsv, and SitePredictionService scenario/delete calls. Supplied upload-history IDs are checked. Site listing take is capped at 1000.
CompletionCriteria: Local predicate isolation and SQL translation pass; staging mutation tests and all other MapView/ExcelUpload routes remain to be verified.

Status: Implemented and unit-verified; live datastore/replay tests pending
Finding: Long-lived cookies and fail-open revocation checks
ImpactAndLimits: Default lifetime is 3650 days; missing Redis login-lock key or unavailable Redis preserves principal; logout deletes that key.
Remediation: 30-minute default idle and 1-day absolute sessions (configurable); region-scoped v2 Redis locks; production requires Redis. Validate active account, current password version, role/company and lock on each cookie request; reject missing/changed state and storage failures.
CompletionCriteria: Local credential/deactivation/role/absolute-expiry tests pass. Verify actual cookie logout/reset replay, Redis failover, and per-request database validation latency on staging.

Status: Runtime migration blocked by automatic approval review
Finding: CSRF enforcement defaults off when flag is absent
ImpactAndLimits: Base configuration omits Security:RequireCsrfHeader and middleware defaults false. Production example is not automatically loaded.
Remediation: Prepared review-only csrf-migration.patch with identity-bound ASP.NET antiforgery, token endpoint, signed identity identifier, production default, and POST legacy logout. It is not applied. Existing custom CSRF behavior/configuration remains.
CompletionCriteria: Approval plus frontend token-flow integration, login/write/GET-logout compatibility review and staging tests; see proposals/README.md.

Status: Fixed locally; proxy deployment retest pending
Finding: Cookie transport helper bypassed proxy trust and could clear Secure
ImpactAndLimits: Helper read raw X-Forwarded-Proto and reset Secure on HTTP; HSTS ran before forwarded headers.
Remediation: Trust Request.IsHttps after trusted forwarding; preserve existing Secure; move forwarded headers before HSTS.
CompletionCriteria: Local tests cover spoofed/untrusted/trusted forwarding and HTTP/HTTPS cookie flags; verify real proxy allowlist and Set-Cookie headers.

Status: Fixed by pipeline inspection; deployed load test pending
ImpactAndLimits: Upload/report policies saw anonymous principal and used IP partition even for signed-in requests.
Remediation: Moved limiter after authentication and scoped user partitions by signed region. Distributed/multi-instance policies remain to be reviewed.
CompletionCriteria: Build passes; staging same-IP/different-user and same-user/multiple-IP tests verify intended partitions.

Finding: Download proxy validates initial URL but follows redirects
ImpactAndLimits: Anonymous GET/HEAD allows one HTTPS host/path but follows redirects without revalidating destination; no resource ownership check.
Remediation: Require authentication and Report rate limit; ordinary users need an exact Download_path on an accessible project. Disable redirects, reject non-443/userinfo URLs, use generic upstream errors, cap transfer at 500 MiB and 2 minutes.
CompletionCriteria: Local URL-shape and auth tests pass. Verify real project-link association, redirects, chunked limit/abort, timeouts and authorized downloads on staging.

Status: Partial hardening verified locally; workload-bound review open
Finding: Upload/query work bounds and storage lifecycle need full review
ImpactAndLimits: Global upload limits and ZIP bounds exist, but site listing has no maximum take, headers use ReadLine, and rejected upload cleanup is absent in the reviewed path.
Remediation: Site listing cap 1000; bounded 65,536-character CSV header reads; ZIP entry cap 1000 and total declared extracted size 500 MiB; cleanup private ProcessCSV staging files; rate limit alternate MapView site upload.
CompletionCriteria: Existing site CSV/ZIP tests plus oversized-header/archive-count tests pass. Complete data-row/field/query/concurrency bounds with representative workloads.

Status: Automatic production startup DDL disabled; other runtime DDL review open

Remediation: Startup schema helpers now require Development plus explicit DatabaseMaintenance:RunStartupSchemaChanges. Other service-level Ensure* schema changes still require migration/least-privilege review.
CompletionCriteria: Reviewed schema prerequisites must be applied before deployment; verify no service requires DDL at runtime before claiming a least-privilege app identity.

Finding: Company-user creation could create super-admins by default
Evidence: Controllers/CompanyController.cs: CreateCompanyUser and account/license mutation actions
ImpactAndLimits: Creation defaulted role to 3 and ordinary users could reach account/license mutations.
Remediation: Creation now requires CompanyAdmin; default role is 1 and only SuperAdmin can assign elevated roles. Scoped company user edits/revokes/deletes require CompanyAdmin and cannot target admins; inspected license mutations require SuperAdmin.
CompletionCriteria: 96-case middleware matrix plus direct company-admin role-escalation rejection pass; verify legitimate admin workflows and target ownership on staging.

Status: Fixed locally; delivery/expiry/replay staging tests pending
Finding: Unsigned password-reset timestamp and caller-controlled link origin
ImpactAndLimits: The reset timestamp could be edited, URL origin used Host, and null CAPTCHA values could compare equal.
Remediation: 15-minute protected tokens; configured HTTPS PasswordResetBaseUrl; encoded email content; removed hardcoded alternate recipient; reject empty CAPTCHA and consume recovery UID atomically. Removed UID/token from reviewed admin response projections.
CompletionCriteria: Token round-trip/tamper/expiry/legacy-format tests pass. Configure URL, verify email delivery, concurrent token replay, and password-reset cookie invalidation.
